_comment: Line coverage for the Node-side logic. Consumed by `c8 report` from scripts/coverage/report.js; the raw V8 files in temp-directory are written by `npm run coverage` (scripts/coverage/run.js). `all` reports a file no test loaded at 0% instead of omitting it. Inline <script> blocks in .html pages are NOT c8's job - see scripts/coverage/browser.js and docs/coverage.md.
